name: network.pocket/agentic-portal-mcp
title: Pocket Network Agentic Marketplace
description: Search and call pay-per-request data services, paying in USDC on Base with x402.

environmentVariables.name: POCKET_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Key of the paying wallet (64 hex characters). Without it only the free tools work. Use a wallet made for this.

environmentVariables.name: POCKET_MAX_TOTAL_ATOMIC
environmentVariables.description: Most the server will sign for in total while it runs, in atomic units (USDC: 1000000 = $1.00). Required to pay.

environmentVariables.name: POCKET_MAX_PER_CALL_ATOMIC
environmentVariables.description: Most it will sign for one call, in atomic units. Default: the highest price in the catalogue.

environmentVariables.name: POCKET_NETWORK
environmentVariables.description: The only network it signs on (CAIP-2).

environmentVariables.name: POCKET_QUOTE_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: true: return the seller terms and never pay.
